facts.text: **Carlos Alcaraz** beat Alex de Minaur 6-1, 6-4 to win the Vienna Open — his fourth title of the year and 28th overall.
facts.plain: Carlos Alcaraz beat Alex de Minaur 6-1, 6-4 to win the Vienna Open — his fourth title of the year and 28th overall.

facts.text: **Alexander Zverev** (Germany, 29) will become **world No. 1** for the first time, replacing **Jannik Sinner** — the 30th different men's No. 1 and the oldest first-timer since **John Newcombe (1974)**. ATP rankings began in **1973**.

facts.text: **Elena Rybakina** (Kazakhstan) secured the **year-end WTA No. 1** ranking; she first became No. 1 last month while winning the **US Open**, replacing **Aryna Sabalenka**.
